title: A catalog you can read without the files
changes: Videos now get a thumbnail of their opening frame, and PDFs a snapshot of their first page — previously only photographs had one.
The Catalog page lists every resource it remembers, with its preview, name and what has been recorded about it.
That list is built from the catalog file alone, so it still shows what each resource is on a machine that cannot reach the originals, or after they have moved.
A material added from another folder that also exists in the connected folder is no longer listed twice — the folder copy is kept, and any notes recorded against the outside copy move onto it.
Clicking the version in the sidebar now opens the release notes — the panel was being painted underneath the page.
Every deployment records a build number, and docs/RELEASES.md is regenerated with what shipped in each one.
The release panel now opens with a full list of what the Studio does, not only what changed most recently.
